text:
Case note: Complaint No. 763/2022
Client: Abhishek Bansal (taxi driver, Ahmedabad)
Opposing party: Shetty Technologies Pvt Ltd
Court: Ahmedabad Labour Court
Filed on: 5 July 2022
Claim amount: Rs 21,40,000
Issue: wrongful termination. The dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry.
Advice given: Demand the domestic enquiry report and challenge it for breach of natural justice.
Outcome: The enquiry was set aside for breach of natural justice.
Recommended next step: Attend the fresh enquiry.
Witness: Vikram Khan
